title: France workers hold protest to demand higher wages

ai.summary: French workers participated in nationwide protests demanding higher wages and supporting student movements amid budget disputes, with authorities deploying over 70,000 police to ensure peaceful demonstrations.

facts.claim: Hundreds of workers took part in the major protests in France on Thursday
facts.quote: Hundreds of workers took part in the major protests in France on Thursday

facts.claim: Trade unions took part in the protests in France on Thursday to demand higher wages and in support of the high school protest movement
facts.quote: Trade unions took part in the protests in France on Thursday to demand higher wages and in support of the high school protest movement

facts.claim: French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said that over 70,000 law enforcement personnel will be deployed on Thursday
facts.quote: French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said that over 70,000 law enforcement personnel will be deployed on Thursday
